text:
sara_support: GlidePay (org: glidepay-prod) reporting persistent 503s and timeouts on /v1/generate since ~08:30 PT. High client retry fanout from their SDK is amplifying the issue and causing a billing spike. Repro steps + sample request_id below. ping @miguel_oncall @alex_sdk @raj_billing for triage

miguel_oncall: ACK. Can you paste a sample request_id + the exact curl or SDK call you used to repro? Also which region?

glidepay_engineer: sample request_id: rp_20260315_0932. Region: us-west2. Repro curl and python (we used sdk v1.4.2):
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-j","input":"hello"}'
```
```
# python repro (pseudo)
from redwood import Redwood
c = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('KEY'))
for _ in range(200):
    c.generate(model='gpt-j', input='hello')
```

glidepay_engineer: response headers (truncated):
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-edge-node: edge-usw2-12
x-request-id: rp_20260315_0932
body: "gateway overloaded, try again"

alex_sdk: thanks. Two things to try immediately: 1) disable aggressive client retries (v1.4.2 retries aggressively on 5xx+connection resets), set retries=2 with exponential backoff; 2) reduce concurrency from 50->10 while we investigate. I can push a quick SDK patch but advise client to change config now. Also can you attach the SDK debug logs (first 1kB)?

emma_se: infra note: ingress p99 and connection queues spike around 08:20-08:40. There's a NAT churn pattern from a small set of IPs (matches GlidePay infra). Might be a connection reuse/keepalive issue causing the proxy pool to fill and cascade 503s. Miguel can you check proxy pool and queued_read_timeouts?

miguel_oncall: pulling edge logs now. I see downstream resets + queued_read_timeouts for that tenant. Also deploy-bot shows an edge config deploy at 08:05 (r-edge-config-20260315). Possible correlation. For mitigation: 1) scaling edge worker pool up 2x, 2) temporarily rollback the edge route config, 3) enable a fallback model variant to reduce per-request load. Doing steps 1 and 2 now.

alex_sdk: note on fallback: model-compat-gptj-1.2 is cheaper and lower latency but may change outputs — communicate that to the customer if used. For repro script for our infra team: run a looped POST at concurrency 50 x1000 with SDK defaults. Expect 503 spike when retries fan out. Example quick script (bash):
```
seq 1 1000 | xargs -n1 -P50 -I{} curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}\n" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"gpt-j","input":"hi"}'
```

glidepay_engineer: reproduced — when we disable retries client-side, error rate drops dramatically. But our billing shows a ton of retry requests already recorded.

raj_billing: please DM me the org id + list of affected request_ids (or a time window). I will open a billing investigation and propose a one-time credit if the retry storm was triggered by our edge behavior. For now I can pause auto-invoicing for 2026-03-15 08:20-09:10 PT for GlidePay pending outcome.

sara_support: communicating short mitigation to customer now: 1) set SDK retries=2 and backoff to (0.5, 2.0), 2) reduce concurrency, 3) optionally switch to model-compat-gptj-1.2 fallback if they accept quality tradeoff. We will follow up with RCA and billing.

deploy-bot: deploy completed r-edge-config-20260315 at 2026-03-15T08:05:12Z by infra-release (no auto-rollback).

miguel_oncall: rolled back r-edge-config-20260315 at 2026-03-15T09:02:10Z. Monitoring now. Early metrics: 5xx rate for that tenant down ~70% in last 5m, connection queue length decreasing.

glidepay_engineer: behavior improved after rollback and disabling retries. Thanks. We'll keep retries disabled for 30m and report if anything reoccurs.

emma_se: follow-up action items: create internal incident postmortem, add a detection that flags sudden retry fanout correlated to recent config deploys, and add a short-runbook for customers to quickly disable retries. Assign to @miguel_oncall and @alex_sdk.

mike_pm: please draft customer comms about the incident and the mitigation steps + expected credit.

sara_support: I will draft comms and include proposed credit once raj confirms numbers. Marking this thread for update in 1h.

miguel_oncall: final note: watch for residual client retries — if we still see spikes after 10m, we may need to temporarily throttle that tenant at the edge until clients update.

glidepay_engineer: understood. Thanks everyone for the quick response.
